117561.name: Chabad of Northridge
117561.note: L'Chaim weekly no. 827 (Pinchas 5764, July 2004): 'On the other side of the United States, Rabbi Eli and Tzippy Rivkin have opened Chabad of Northridge, California.' A report from the year itself, which also answers whether there was a Chabad of Northridge before them. Anash.org (Nov 2020): the Rivkins 'have been directing Chabad activities in Northridge since 2004'; its '10 Year Anniversary Fund' (June 2014) agrees. (therebbesimpact.com's 1988 is wrong.) Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked. (The L'Chaim page was down when checked; the sentence is in the search index's copy.)

3399630.name: Chabad of North Ranch
3399630.note: Oak Park Talon, Sept 17 2019 (Oliver Carter, 'The Chabad House of North Ranch'): 'Rabbi Shlomo Bistritzky opened The Chabad House of North Ranch four years ago in Westlake Village', so about 2015 (therebbesimpact.com: 2015; the listing number points to 2016). Counted back, so medium. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked.

4803080.name: Chabad Canoga Park
4803080.note: Its Charidy campaign 'LAUNCH2022', written as 2021 ended: 'We recently started our Shlichus and opened the doors for Chabad of Canoga Park ... As 2021 comes to an end'; its nonprofit's EIN (87-3107628) is from 2021 and its chabad.org listing from late 2020. Its later 'FUEL2023' campaign page says 'We moved to the Los Angeles Valley in March of 2022, opening the doors for Chabad Of Canoga Park' (https://www.jewishcanogapark.com/templates/fundraising/default_cdo/aid/5644020/jewish/Campaign.htm), which can't be right if it had opened by late 2021 (probably March 2021). Medium because the center's own two pages disagree.

2886998.name: Chabad of Ojai
2886998.note: COLlive, Mar 14 2015 ('New Shluchim to California "Village"'): 'Rabbi Mordy and Rochel Nemtzov are founding Chabad of Ojai ... The Los Angeles residents will be conducting their first activity in 3 weeks when they will be holding a community Passover seder ... After the 8 day holiday, the Nemtzovs will be moving permanently to Ojai'. Its About page was first published May 13 2015. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked.

767122.name: The Rohr Chabad at UC Irvine
767122.note: Orange County Register, Sept 26 2009 ('New UCI Chabad observes Yom Kippur'): 'Rabbi Zev Tenenbaum's new Chabad at UC Irvine ... prepares for the group's first Yom Kippur on campus. Rabbi and Miriam Tenenbaum, who arrived at UCI eight months ago' (about Jan 2009), opening 'their home adjacent to campus'. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked.
